'''Tim Guzman Part 1-Insert Cards Think Positive''' is a strategy article [[Tim Guzman]] published on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]] as The Information Broker, under the title ''Part 1-Insert Cards.....Think Positive''.<ref name="or">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Inserts1.htm Part 1-Insert Cards.....Think Positive], The Outer Rim (The Information Broker). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261030142004/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Inserts1.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Article ==

<blockquote>
<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:inherit"><nowiki>
Title: Part 1-Insert
Cards.....Think Positive

These cards came
out with the Dagabah expansion. Well at least the Inserts that effect the
game the most like NTMTO or 3721, is the ones I will be talking about. There
has been alot of articles on inserts on other sites and I filt that we can
give an opinion on them here. Did Decipher realize the impact these cards
were going to have in the game? Well once Decipher stated that these cards
create a certain kink of balance in the game. What Decipher may have deen
thinking is they wanted players who don't go to tournaments because they don't
have MAINS to start showing up. So in other words that the inexperience players
would have a cance against the more experience players. Well what happen was
that the experience players started playing with these cards instead and new
players and old got a little discouraged about the game. I know a few people
who stop playing because of them. So basically, Yes, these cards were cheese
when it first came out. Well actually its cheese still now, but with Cloud
City, and JP it cards that can be dealt with. So don't thing there is not
a way out. Cards like Ability, ability, ability or Civil Disorder, Resistance,
or Ultamium put the right kind of balance to it. These are cards that Encourage
battles which is something good wouldn't you say. Plus it still allows your
opponent to play numbers because he may not have the MAINS to play with. Torture
or DFTD are also good at stoping Numbers and have a good destiny also. So
with these cards its a little harder for the die hard number player to get
around, but it does encourage players to start playing with cards to have
interaction with your opponent. You shouldn't be able to win with Numbers
ONLY anymore. There should be something esle that your deck offers, thanks
again to these cards. Remember when Captein Solo entered the Astroid feild
he was playing the odds, so I guess Decipher thought if we play JUST mains
there will be a risk to it. But Stay Positive like the title Says. A lot of
people have negative things to say about inserts (including Myself). But I
have come to realize that there are ways to Handle numbers and I have learned
that a balanced Deck wins more games than a cheese Deck. So if your opponent
is playing with numbers show him that you can beat the odds, Hey Han Solo
seems to do it more ways than one.


The
Information Broker
</nowiki></div>
</blockquote>
